newsitem.title: FRANCE: DASA says Europe has to react to defence deals.
newsitem.headline: DASA says Europe has to react to defence deals.

text.p: Manfred Bischoff, chairman of Daimler Aerospace (DASA), said it was high time that Europe reacted to further concentration in the U.S. defence industry.

"I think the decision just taken in the U.S. on Boeing and McDonnell Douglas, on rockets, Lockheed Martin acquiring Northrop Grumman, shows that Europe has to react," he told reporters after a meeting with the defence commission of the National Assembly.
"It is high time that we do something in Europe. I hope that we can improve the understanding of all the partners in Europe," he added.
Asked to comment whether he believed the privatisation of Thomson-CSF would continue and whether plane maker Airbus should be privatised, Bischoff said this was an issue for the French.
"France has to decide what it thinks is best, I think the most important thing is that we get decent European structures," Bischoff said.
"It is clear from our point of view that structures on a private basis are a preferable solution to us. But they are, at least not for Airbus, any precondition," he said.
